verdict.rationale: Stripe ships an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API and search its docs/support knowledge base, plus agent 'skills', a CLI sandbox provisioning flow made for coding agents, and llms.txt for LLM consumption — strong agentic tooling. However, this is developer/agent-oriented infrastructure (requires API keys, MCP client setup) rather than a natural-language interface for end-users to directly operate the product, and there's no community evidence validating real-world natural-language usage quality.
